rows.grounds: tejomātrātmanā = as-consisting-only-of-light (bahuvrīhi compound: tejas+mātra+ātman, instrumental singular)
dhyātaṃ = meditated-on (past passive participle, neuter nominative singular)
sarvamāpyāyayedvidhim = he-should-nourish-the-whole-rite (sandhi-joined sequence: sarvam + āpyāyayet + vidhim)
mantragaṇaṃ = the-mantra-assembly (tatpuruṣa compound: mantra+gaṇa, masculine accusative singular)
sarvaṃ = all (masculine accusative singular, agreeing with mantragaṇam)
